sentences.text: Ligilactobacillus is one of the genera proposed when the genus Lactobacillus was reclassified into 25 genera on the basis of whole genome sequences.

A review describes Limosilactobacillus and Ligilactobacillus as host- and food-associated genera that include several reported bacteriocin producers, whose strains come from niches such as the gastrointestinal tract, oral cavity and poultry.
Ligilactobacillus salivarius is described as a well-recognized probiotic species, and a study characterised a human-derived strain that adhered strongly to intestinal epithelial cell lines.

Ligilactobacillus ruminis has been reported as a flagellated bacterium of the intestines of various mammals including humans, although flagella formation has not been observed in human-derived strains.
